_about: Hand review of every diff that made all target tests pass, plus the cause of death read from the 3.13 test output. Written after the runs; not seen by any model.

cause_of_death.zipfile36: Its bundled copy of CPython's test.support imports nntplib, which Python 3.13 removed. The library itself was fine.
cause_of_death.pep8: Python 3.12's new tokenizer reports some errors differently (e.g. null bytes), so pep8's self-test expectations no longer match.
cause_of_death.kafka: The vendored six's import hook only implements find_module/load_module, which Python 3.12 stopped calling; kafka.vendor.six.moves no longer imports.
cause_of_death.cookies: A regex with a global inline flag group (?ix) in the middle of a pattern; an error since Python 3.11.
cause_of_death.pyxb: Same vendored-six import hook as kafka, plus more 3.13 changes behind it.
cause_of_death.logutils: logging._acquireLock/_releaseLock, private helpers, were removed in Python 3.13.
cause_of_death.paver: distutils was removed in 3.12; without setuptools installed there is no distutils at all, and paver's tests are built on it.
cause_of_death.python3-ldap: collections.MutableMapping/Mapping aliases were removed in Python 3.10.
cause_of_death.money: distutils.version.StrictVersion: distutils was removed in Python 3.12.

bench-deepseek-v4-flash-kafka.note: Adds find_spec/create_module/exec_module to the vendored six importer: the same shape as the fix six itself shipped in 1.16.0.

bench-deepseek-v4-flash-python3-ldap.note: Imports MutableMapping/Mapping from collections.abc with a fallback for old Pythons.

bench-qwen3-30b-a3b-null.note: collections.abc import, no fallback (fine: collections.abc exists since 3.3).

bench-deepseek-v4-flash-money.note: Falls back to packaging.version (importable here only because pytest depends on it), else to a hand-written StrictVersion that only understands dotted integers. Fine for the Babel version check it guards; declaring packaging would be cleaner.

bench-deepseek-v4-flash-zipfile36.verdict: works, but the library was never dead
bench-deepseek-v4-flash-zipfile36.note: Adds a 27-line nntplib.py stub at the sdist root so the bundled test.support can import it. zipfile36 itself is untouched: it was the test kit that died.

round2-deepseek-v4-flash-logutils.note: Re-creates logging._acquireLock/_releaseLock on the stdlib logging module when missing. Works on 3.8 and 3.13, but patches a global module; a private helper inside logutils would be tidier.

smoke-deepseek-v4-flash-money.note: Same approach as the bench run; its fallback class only defines __lt__.

chaos-deepseek-v4-flash-money.note: Falls back to packaging.version.Version. packaging is importable here only because pytest depends on it; a real release would have to declare it.
